name: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Biotechnology
description: Approved comprehensive 6-semester undergraduate syllabus for B.Sc. (Hons.) in Biotechnology under Patna University, offered at premier constituent colleges including Patna Science College and B.N. College. Rigorous curriculum spanning cell biology, biochemistry, general microbiology, molecular biology, genetics, immunology, recombinant DNA technology, bioprocess engineering, bioinformatics, genomics, and industrial biotechnology.

papers.name: Cell Biology
recommendedBooks: Molecular Biology of the Cell - Alberts et al., Garland Science
Cell and Molecular Biology - De Robertis & De Robertis, Lippincott
The Cell: A Molecular Approach - Geoffrey M. Cooper, Sinauer Associates

units.title: Introduction to Cell Biology & Cell Wall
topics: Discovery of cells and Cell Theory; Comparative architecture of prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells
Structure and chemical composition of plant cell wall and bacterial cell wall
Extracellular matrix and cell junctions (tight junctions, desmosomes, gap junctions)

units.title: Plasma Membrane & Transport Mechanisms
topics: Membrane models: Evolution from Danielli-Davson to Singer-Nicolson Fluid Mosaic model
Membrane lipids, proteins and carbohydrates; Membrane fluidity and lipid rafts
Transport across membrane: Passive diffusion, facilitated diffusion, active transport (Na+/K+ ATPase, ABC transporters), ion channels, endocytosis and exocytosis

units.title: Cytoplasmic Organelles & Cytoskeleton
topics: Structure and functions of Endoplasmic Reticulum (RER & SER), protein folding and glycosylation
Golgi apparatus: Architecture, protein sorting and vesicular trafficking
Lysosomes, peroxisomes and vacuoles: Biogenesis and enzymatic functions
Semiautonomous organelles: Mitochondria (chemiosmosis, Cristae structure) and Chloroplasts (thylakoids, stroma); Endosymbiotic theory
Cytoskeletal network: Microfilaments (actin), microtubules (tubulin) and intermediate filaments

units.title: Nucleus & Cell Cycle Regulation
topics: Nuclear envelope, nuclear pore complex (NPC) and nucleolus structure
Chromatin organization: Nucleosome model, euchromatin and heterochromatin
Cell division: Phases and molecular events of Mitosis and Meiosis
Cell cycle checkpoints (G1/S, G2/M, spindle assembly), cyclins and cyclin-dependent kinases (CDKs), basics of apoptosis (programmed cell death)

papers.name: Cell Biology - Practical
recommendedBooks: Laboratory Manual in Cell and Molecular Biology - P.K. Gupta, Rastogi
Experimental Cell Biology - H.B. Rao, Himalaya Publishing

units.title: Cell Biology Laboratory Exercises
topics: Operation and calibration of compound microscope and ocular/stage micrometry
Preparation of temporary squash mounts of onion root tips to study stages of mitosis
Study of meiosis in grasshopper testes or flower buds of Allium cepa
Measurement of cell size and cell viability assay using Trypan Blue exclusion test

papers.name: Biochemistry & Biophysics
recommendedBooks: Lehninger Principles of Biochemistry - David L. Nelson & Michael M. Cox, W.H. Freeman
Biochemistry - Donald Voet & Judith G. Voet, Wiley
Biophysics: Principles and Techniques - P.K. Srivastava, Rastogi

units.title: Aqueous Chemistry & Bioenergetics
topics: Structure of water, ionization, pH, pKa, Henderson-Hasselbalch equation and biological buffer systems
Non-covalent interactions: Hydrogen bonds, hydrophobic interactions, ionic bonds, van der Waals forces
Bioenergetics: Laws of thermodynamics, free energy change (delta G), high-energy phosphate compounds and ATP hydrolysis

units.title: Carbohydrates & Lipids
topics: Classification, stereochemistry (D/L, optical isomerism) and ring structures of monosaccharides
Disaccharides (sucrose, lactose, maltose) and structural/storage polysaccharides (starch, glycogen, cellulose, chitin)
Fatty acids: Saturated, unsaturated, essential fatty acids; Triacylglycerols, phospholipids, glycolipids, sphingolipids and cholesterol biological significance

units.title: Amino Acids, Peptides & Proteins
topics: Classification, structure, physical properties and zwitterionic nature of standard 20 amino acids
Peptide bond formation, Ramachandran plot and conformational angles (phi, psi)
Levels of protein architecture: Primary sequence, secondary structures (alpha-helix, beta-pleated sheets, turns), tertiary conformation and quaternary structures (hemoglobin vs myoglobin)

units.title: Nucleic Acids & Biophysical Techniques
topics: Purine and pyrimidine bases, nucleosides and nucleotides; Watson-Crick double helix structure of DNA (A, B and Z forms)
Denaturation and renaturation of DNA, hyperchromic effect, Tm value and RNA structural diversity (mRNA, tRNA, rRNA)
Biophysical tools: Principles of spectrophotometry (Beer-Lambert law), UV-visible absorbance, pH metry

papers.name: Biochemistry - Practical
recommendedBooks: Practical Biochemistry: Principles and Techniques - Keith Wilson & John Walker, Cambridge
An Introduction to Practical Biochemistry - David T. Plummer, McGraw Hill

units.title: Biochemical Analysis Laboratory Exercises
topics: Preparation of physiological and laboratory buffers (phosphate, acetate, Tris-HCl buffer)
Qualitative biochemical tests for carbohydrates (Molisch, Fehling, Benedict, Barfoed, Iodine test)
Qualitative tests for proteins and amino acids (Biuret, Ninhydrin, Xanthoproteic test)
Quantitative estimation of proteins using Bradford / Lowry method with standard calibration curve
Separation of amino acid mixture using ascending paper chromatography

papers.name: Chemistry for Life Sciences
recommendedBooks: Organic Chemistry - Paula Yurkanis Bruice, Pearson
Inorganic Chemistry - J.D. Lee, Wiley

units.title: Chemical Bonding & Reaction Mechanisms
topics: Atomic structure, periodic trends, electronegativity and valence bond vs molecular orbital theory
Ionic, covalent and coordinate covalent bonding in metalloproteins and biomolecules
Organic reaction mechanisms: Nucleophilic substitution (SN1, SN2), electrophilic addition, condensation and esterification reactions

units.title: Stereochemistry & Coordination Chemistry
topics: Optical isomerism, enantiomers, diastereomers, meso compounds and R/S configuration in biological compounds
Coordination chemistry: Werner theory, ligands, chelation therapy and biological role of coordination complexes (hemoglobin, chlorophyll, Vitamin B12)

papers.name: General Microbiology
recommendedBooks: Microbiology - Lansing M. Prescott, John P. Harley & Donald A. Klein, McGraw Hill
Brock Biology of Microorganisms - Michael T. Madigan et al., Pearson
General Microbiology - Stanier et al., Macmillan

units.title: History, Classification & Bacterial Structure
topics: Spontaneous generation controversy, germ theory of disease (Louis Pasteur, Robert Koch) and Koch postulates
Carl Woese Three-Domain system (Archaea, Bacteria, Eukarya) and Bergey Manual of Systematic Bacteriology

Morphology and fine structure of bacteria: Cell wall (Gram-positive vs Gram-negative peptidoglycan structure), plasma membrane, capsule, flagella (arrangements and motility), pili, endospores and inclusion bodies

units.title: Microbial Nutrition & Cultivation
topics: Nutritional categories: Phototrophs, chemotrophs, lithotrophs, organotrophs, autotrophs, heterotrophs
Culture media: Synthetic, complex, selective, differential, enriched and transport media
Pure culture techniques: Streak plate, pour plate, spread plate and serial dilution method; Preservation of microbial cultures (cryopreservation, lyophilization)

units.title: Microbial Growth Kinetics & Control
topics: Bacterial growth curve: Lag, log (exponential), stationary and decline phases; Generation time and specific growth rate
Factors affecting microbial growth: Temperature (psychrophiles, mesophiles, thermophiles), pH, oxygen (aerobes, anaerobes), water activity and osmotic pressure
Physical and chemical control of microorganisms: Moist heat (autoclave), dry heat (hot air oven), filtration, radiation, disinfectants and antiseptics

units.title: Virology, Fungi & Microbial Pathogenesis
topics: General characteristics and structure of viruses: Capsid symmetries (helical, icosahedral, complex); Bacteriophages: Lytic cycle of T4 and lysogenic cycle of Lambda phage
Overview of medically important bacteria, fungi (Candida, Aspergillus) and protozoans
Antimicrobial agents: Mechanism of action of antibiotics (penicillin, streptomycin, tetracycline) and drug resistance development

papers.name: General Microbiology - Practical
recommendedBooks: Microbiology: A Laboratory Manual - James G. Cappuccino & Natalie Sherman, Pearson
Laboratory Experiments in Microbiology - Ted R. Johnson & Christine L. Case, Pearson

units.title: Microbiology Laboratory Exercises
topics: Good microbiological laboratory practices and standard operating procedures for autoclave, laminar air flow and incubator
Preparation and sterilization of solid (nutrient agar) and liquid (nutrient broth) culture media
Smear preparation and simple staining using crystal violet/methylene blue
Differential Gram staining technique and microscopic observation of Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria
Isolation of pure bacterial colonies by streak-plate method from mixed environmental sample

papers.name: Plant & Animal Physiology
recommendedBooks: Plant Physiology and Development - Lincoln Taiz & Eduardo Zeiger, Sinauer Associates
Guyton and Hall Textbook of Medical Physiology - John E. Hall, Elsevier
Animal Physiology - Richard W. Hill, Sinauer Associates

units.title: Plant Water Relations & Mineral Nutrition
topics: Diffusion, osmosis, water potential, ascent of sap and transpiration mechanisms; Stomatal movement regulation
Essential macro and micronutrients; Nitrogen metabolism: Nitrogen fixation (symbiotic vs asymbiotic) and nitrate assimilation

units.title: Plant Photosynthesis & Growth Regulators
topics: Photosynthetic pigments, light reaction (Z-scheme, cyclic & non-cyclic photophosphorylation), Calvin cycle (C3 pathway), C4 pathway, CAM and photorespiration
Plant growth hormones: Physiological functions of auxins, gibberellins, cytokinins, ethylene and abscisic acid (ABA); Photoperiodism and vernalization

units.title: Animal Digestion, Circulation & Respiration
topics: Digestion and absorption of carbohydrates, proteins and lipids; Gastrointestinal hormones
Composition of blood, blood coagulation cascade, cardiac cycle, blood pressure and ECG overview
Mechanism of pulmonary respiration, transport of respiratory gases (oxygen-hemoglobin dissociation curve, Bohr effect)

units.title: Excretion, Neuro-Endocrine Coordination
topics: Structure of nephron, glomerular filtration, tubular reabsorption, counter-current mechanism and urine concentration
Nerve impulse transmission: Resting membrane potential, action potential propagation and synaptic transmission
Endocrine glands: Hormones and target organ actions of pituitary, thyroid, parathyroid, adrenal, pancreas and gonads

papers.name: Physiology - Practical
recommendedBooks: Practical Botany - Bendre & Kumar, Rastogi Publications
A Manual of Practical Zoology - P.S. Verma, S. Chand

units.title: Physiological Experiments
topics: Separation of photosynthetic pigments from fresh spinach leaves using paper chromatography
Demonstration of transpiration rate using Ganong photometer
Determination of human ABO and Rh blood groups using agglutination test
Estimation of hemoglobin content using Sahli hemometer and total RBC/WBC count using hemocytometer

papers.name: Biostatistics & Analytical Instrumentation
recommendedBooks: Biostatistical Analysis - Jerrold H. Zar, Pearson
Principles and Techniques of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology - Keith Wilson & John Walker, Cambridge

units.title: Biostatistics & Biological Hypotheses
topics: Sampling techniques, tabulation and graphical representation of biological experimental data
Measures of central tendency (mean, median, mode) and dispersion (standard deviation, standard error, variance)
Testing of statistical hypothesis: Student t-test (paired and unpaired), Chi-square test for goodness of fit and independence

units.title: Analytical Instrumentation in Biotechnology
topics: Principles and types of centrifugation: Differential, density gradient and ultracentrifugation
Chromatographic techniques: TLC, column chromatography, gel filtration, ion exchange and affinity chromatography
Electrophoretic techniques: Agarose gel electrophoresis (AGE) and SDS-PAGE principles

papers.name: Genetics

units.title: UNIT I
topics: Introduction: Historical developments in the field of genetics. Organisms suitable for genetic experimentation and their genetic significance.
Cell Cycle: Mitosis and Meiosis: Control points in cell-cycle progression in yeast. Role of meiosis in life cycles of organisms.

Mendelian genetics : Mendel's experimental design, monohybrid, di-hybrid and tri hybrid crosses, Law of segregation & Principle of independent assortment. Verification of segregates by test and back crosses, Chromosomal theory of inheritance, Allelic interactions: Concept of dominance, recessiveness, incomplete dominance, co-dominance, semi-dominance, pleiotropy, multiple allele, pseudo-allele, essential and lethal genes, penetrance and expressivity.

units.title: UNIT II
topics: Non allelic interactions: Interaction producing new phenotype complementary genes, epistasis (dominant & recessive), duplicate genes and inhibitory genes.

Chromosome and genomic organization: Eukaryotic nuclear genome nucleotide sequence composition - unique & repetitive DNA, satellite DNA. Centromere and telomere DNA sequences, middle repetitive sequences- VNTRs & dinucleotide repeats, repetitive transposed sequences- SINEs & LINEs, middle repetitive multiple copy genes, noncoding DNA. Genetic organization of prokaryotic and viral genome.

Structure and characteristics of bacterial and eukaryotic chromosome, chromosome morphology, concept of euchromatin and heterochromatin. packaging of DNA molecule into chromosomes, chromosome banding pattern, karyotype, giant chromosomes, one gene one polypeptide hypothesis, concept of cistron, exons, introns, genetic code, gene function.

units.title: UNIT III
topics: Chromosome and gene mutations: Definition and types of mutations, causes of mutations, Ames test for mutagenic agents, screening procedures for isolation of mutants and uses of mutants, variations in chromosomes structure - deletion, duplication, inversion and translocation (reciprocal and Robertsonian), position effects of gene expression, chromosomal aberrations in human beings, abnormalities- Aneuploidy and Euploidy.

Sex determination and sex linkage: Mechanisms of sex determination, Environmental factors and sex determination, sex differentiation, Barr bodies, dosage compensation, genetic balance theory, Fragile-X-syndrome and chromosome, sex influenced dominance, sex limited gene expression, sex linked inheritance.

units.title: UNIT IV
topics: Genetic linkage, crossing over and chromosome mapping: Linkage and Recombination of genes in a chromosome crossing over, Cytological basis of crossing over, Molecular mechanism of crossing over, Crossing over at four strand stage, Multiple crossing overs Genetic mapping.
Extra chromosomal inheritance: Rules of extra nuclear inheritance, maternal effects, maternal inheritance, cytoplasmic inheritance, organelle heredity, genomic imprinting.

Evolution and population genetics: In breeding and out breeding, Hardy Weinberg law (prediction, derivation), allelic and genotype frequencies, changes in allelic frequencies, systems of mating, evolutionary genetics, natural selection.

recommendedBooks: Gardner, E.J., Simmons, M.J., Snustad, D.P. (2006). Principles of Genetics. VIII Edition John Wiley & Sons.
Snustad, D.P., Simmons, M.J. (2009). Principles of Genetics. V Edition. John Wiley and Sons Inc.
Klug, W.S., Cummings, M.R., Spencer, C.A. (2009). Concepts of Genetics. IX Edition. Benjamin Cummings.
Russell, P. J. (2009). Genetics- A Molecular Approach. III Edition. Benjamin Cummings.
Griffiths, A.J.F., Wessler, S.R., Lewontin, R.C. and Carroll, S.B. IX Edition. Introduction to Genetic Analysis, W. H. Freeman & Co.

units.title: PRACTICALS
topics: Permanent and temporary mount of mitosis.
Permanent and temporary mount of meiosis.
Mendelian deviations in dihybrid crosses
Demonstration of - Barr Body -Rhoeotranslocation.
Karyotyping with the help of photographs
Pedigree charts of some common characters like blood group, color blindness and
Study of polyploidy in onion root tip by colchicine treatment.

papers.name: General Microbiology

units.title: UNIT I
topics: Fundamentals, History and Evolution of Microbiology. Classification of microorganisms: Microbial taxonomy, criteria used including molecular approaches, Microbial phylogeny and current classification of bacteria. Microbial Diversity: Distribution and characterization Prokaryotic and Eukaryotic cells, Morphology and cell structure of major groups of microorganisms eg. Bacteria, Algae, Fungi, Protozoa and Unique features of viruses.

units.title: UNIT II
topics: Cultivation and Maintenance of microorganisms: Nutritional categories of micro-organisms, methods of isolation, Purification and preservation.

units.title: UNIT III
topics: Microbial growth: Growth curve, Generation time, synchronous batch and continuous culture, measurement of growth and factors affecting growth of bacteria.
Microbial Metabolism: Metabolic pathways, amphi-catabolic and biosynthetic pathways Bacterial Reproduction: Transformation, Transduction and Conjugation. Endospores and sporulation in bacteria.

units.title: UNIT IV
topics: Control of Microorganisms: By physical, chemical and chemotherapeutic Agents Water Microbiology: Bacterial pollutants of water, coliforms and non coliforms. Sewage composition and its disposal.
Food Microbiology: Important microorganism in food Microbiology: Moulds, Yeasts, bacteria. Major food born infections and intoxications, Preservation of various types of foods. Fermented Foods.

Stanier RY, Ingraham JL, Wheelis ML, and Painter PR. (2005). General Microbiology. 5th

units.title: PRACTICALS
topics: Isolation of bacteria & their biochemical characterization.
Staining methods: simple staining, Gram staining, spore staining, negative staining, hanging drop.
Preparation of media & sterilization methods, Methods of Isolation of bacteria from different sources.
Determination of bacterial cell size by micrometry.
Enumeration of microorganism - total & viable count.

papers.name: Biostatistics

units.title: UNIT I
topics: Types of Data, Collection of data; Primary & Secondary data, Classification and Graphical representation of Statistical data. Measures of central tendency and Dispersion. Measures of Skewness and Kurtosis.

units.title: UNIT II
topics: Probability classical & axiomatic definition of probability, Theorems on total and compound probability), Elementary ideas of Binomial, Poisson and Normal distributions.

units.title: UNIT III
topics: Methods of sampling, confidence level, critical region, testing of hypothesis and standard error, large sample test and small sample test. Problems on test of significance, t-test, chi-square test for goodness of fit and analysis of variance (ANOVA)

units.title: UNIT IV
topics: Correlation and Regression. Emphasis on examples from Biological Sciences.

recommendedBooks: Le CT (2003) Introductory biostatistics. 1st edition, John Wiley, USA
Glaser AN (2001) High YieldTM Biostatistics. Lippincott Williams and Wilkins, USA
Edmondson A and Druce D (1996) Advanced Biology Statistics, Oxford University Press.
Danial W (2004) Biostatistics: A foundation for Analysis in Health Sciences, John Wiley and Sons Inc.

papers.name: Molecular Diagnostics

units.title: UNIT I
topics: Enzyme Immunoassays: Comparison of enzymes available for enzyme immunoassays, conjugation of enzymes. Solid phases used in enzyme immunoassays. Homogeneous and heterogeneous enzyme immunoassays. Enzyme immunoassays after immuno blotting. Enzyme immuno histochemical techniques. Use of polyclonal or monoclonal antibodies in enzymes immuno assays. Applications of enzyme immunoassays in diagnostic microbiology

units.title: UNIT II
topics: Molecular methods in clinical microbiology: Applications of PCR, RFLP, Nuclear hybridization methods, Single nucleotide polymorphism and plasmid finger printing in clinical microbiology

Laboratory tests in chemotherapy: Susceptibility tests: Micro-dilution and macro-dilution broth procedures. Susceptibility tests: Diffusion test procedures. Susceptibility tests: Tests for bactericidal activity. Automated procedures for antimicrobial susceptibility tests.

units.title: UNIT III
topics: Automation in microbial diagnosis, rapid diagnostic approach including technical purification and standardization of antigen and specific antibodies. Concepts and methods in idiotypes. Antidiotypes and molecular mimicry and receptors. Epitope design and applications. Immunodiagnostic tests. Immuno florescence. Radioimmunoassay.

units.title: UNIT IV
topics: GLC, HPLC, Electron microscopy, flowcytometry and cell sorting.
Transgenic animals.

Bioinstrumentation, Webster
Advanced Instrumentation, Data Interpretation, and Control of Biotechnological Processes, J.F. Van Impe, Kluwer Academic

Goering R, Dockrell H, Zuckerman M and Wakelin D. (2007). Mims' Medical Microbiology. 4th edition. Elsevier.

Willey JM, Sherwood LM, and Woolverton CJ. (2008). Prescott, Harley and Klein's Microbiology. 7th edition. McGraw Hill Higher Education.
Microscopic Techniques in Biotechnology, Michael Hopper

papers.name: Molecular Biology

units.title: UNIT I: DNA structure and replication
topics: DNA as genetic material, Structure of DNA, Types of DNA, Replication of DNA in prokaryotes and eukaryotes: Semiconservative nature of DNA replication, Bi-directional replication, DNA polymerases, The replication complex: Pre-primming proteins, primosome, replisome, Rolling circle replication, Unique aspects of eukaryotic chromosome replication, Fidelity of replication.

units.title: UNIT II: DNA damage, repair and homologous recombination
topics: DNA damage and repair: causes and types of DNA damage, mechanism of DNA repair: Photoreactivation, base excision repair, nucleotide excision repair, mismatch repair, translesion synthesis, recombinational repair, nonhomologous end joining.
Homologous recombination: models and mechanism.

units.title: UNIT III: Transcription and RNA processing
topics: RNA structure and types of RNA, Transcription in prokaryotes: Prokaryotic RNA polymerase, role of sigma factor, promoter, Initiation, elongation and termination of RNA chains Transcription in eukaryotes: Eukaryotic RNA polymerases, transcription factors, promoters, enhancers, mechanism of transcription initiation, promoter clearance and elongation RNA splicing and processing: processing of pre-mRNA: 5' cap formation, polyadenylation, splicing, rRNA and tRNA splicing.

units.title: UNIT IV: Regulation of gene expression and translation
topics: Regulation of gene expression in prokaryotes: Operon concept (inducible and repressible system), Genetic code and its characteristics, Prokaryotic and eukaryotic translation: ribosome structure and assembly, Charging of tRNA, aminoacyl tRNA synthetases, Mechanism of initiation, elongation and termination of polypeptides, Fidelity of translation, Inhibitors of translation.,Posttranslational modifications of proteins.

recommendedBooks: Karp, G. (2010). Cell and Molecular Biology: Concepts and Experiments. VI Edition. John Wiley & Sons. Inc.
De Robertis, E.D.P. and De Robertis, E.M.F. (2006). Cell and Molecular Biology. VIII Edition. Lippincott Williams and Wilkins, Philadelphia.
Becker, W.M., Kleinsmith, L.J., Hardin. J. and Bertoni, G. P. (2009). The World of the Cell. VII Edition. Pearson Benjamin Cummings Publishing, San Francisco.
Watson, J. D., Baker T.A., Bell, S. P., Gann, A., Levine, M., and Losick, R., (2008) Molecular Biology of the Gene (VI Edition.). Cold Spring Harbour Lab. Press, Pearson Pub.

units.title: PRACTICALS
topics: Preparation of solutions for Molecular Biology experiments.
Isolation of chromosomal DNA from bacterial cells.
Isolation of Plasmid DNA by alkaline lysis method
Agarose gel electrophoresis of genomic DNA & plasmid DNA
Preparation of restriction enzyme digests of DNA samples
Demonstration of AMES test or reverse mutation for carcinogenicity

papers.name: Immunology

units.title: UNIT I
topics: Immune Response - An overview, components of mammalian immune system, molecular structure of Immuno-globulins or Antibodies, Humoral & Cellular immune responses, T-lymphocytes & immune response (cytotoxic T-cell, helper T-cell, suppressor T-cells), T-cell receptors, genome rearrangements during B-lymphocyte differentiation, Antibody affinity maturation class switching, assembly of T-cell receptor genes by somatic recombination.

units.title: UNIT II
topics: Regulation of immunoglobulin gene expression - clonal selection theory, allotypes & idiotypes, allelic exclusion, immunologic memory, heavy chain gene transcription, genetic basis of antibody diversity, hypotheses (germ line & somatic mutation), antibody diversity.

units.title: UNIT III
topics: Major Histocompatibility complexes - class I & class II MHC antigens, antigen processing.
Immunity to infection - immunity to different organisms, pathogen defense strategies, avoidance of recognition.
Autoimmune diseases, Immunodeficiency-AIDS.

units.title: UNIT IV
topics: Vaccines & Vaccination - adjuvants, cytokines, DNA vaccines, recombinant vaccines, bacterial vaccines, viral vaccines, vaccines to other infectious agents, passive & active immunization.
Introduction to immunodiagnostics - RIA, ELISA.

recommendedBooks: Abbas AK, Lichtman AH, Pillai S. (2007). Cellular and Molecular Immunology. 6 th edition Saunders Publication, Philadelphia.
Delves P, Martin S, Burton D, Roitt IM. (2006). Roitt's Essential Immunology. 11th edition Wiley-Blackwell Scientific Publication, Oxford.

topics: Differential leucocytes count
Total leucocytes count
Total RBC count
Haemagglutination assay
Haemagglutination inhibition assay
Separation of serum from blood
Double immunodiffusion test using specific antibody and antigen.
ELISA.

papers.name: Developmental Biology

units.title: UNIT I: GAMETOGENESIS AND FERTILIZATION
topics: Definition, scope & historical perspective of development Biology, Gametogenesis - Spermatogenesis, Oogenesis Fertilization - Definition, mechanism, types of fertilization. Different types of eggs on the basis of yolk.

units.title: UNIT II: Early embryonic development
topics: Cleavage: Definition, types, patterns & mechanism Blastulation: Process, types & mechanism Gastrulation: Morphogenetic movements- epiboly, emboly, extension, invagination, convergence, de-lamination. Formation & differentiation of primary germ layers, Fate Maps in early embryos.

units.title: UNIT III: Embryonic Differentiation
topics: Differentiation: Cell commitment and determination- the epigenetic landscape: a model of determination and differentiation, control of differentiation at the level of genome, transcription and post-translation level Concept of embryonic induction: Primary, secondary & tertiary embryonic induction, Neural induction and induction of vertebrate lens.

units.title: UNIT IV: Organogenesis
topics: Neurulation, ontogenesis, development of vertebrate eye. Fate of different primary germ layers Development of behavior: constancy & plasticity, Extra embryonic membranes, placenta in Mammals.

recommendedBooks: Gilbert, S. F. (2006). Developmental Biology, VIII Edition, Sinauer Associates, Inc., Publishers, Sunderland, Massachusetts, USA.
Balinsky, B.I. (2008). An introduction to Embryology, International Thomson Computer Press.
Kalthoff, (2000). Analysis of Biological Development, II Edition, McGraw-Hill Professional

units.title: UNIT - I
topics: Isolation, crystallization and purification of enzymes, test of homogeneity of enzyme preparation, methods of enzyme analysis.
Enzyme classification (rationale, overview and specific examples) Zymogens and their activation (Proteases and Prothrombin).
Enzyme substrate complex: concept of E-S complex, binding sites, active site, specificity, Kinetics of enzyme activity, Michaelis-Menten equation and its derivation,

Different plots for the determination of Km and Vmax and their physiological significance, factors affecting initial rate, E, S, temp. &pH. Collision and transition state theories, Significance of activation energy and free energy.

units.title: UNIT - II
topics: Two substrate reactions (Random, ordered and ping-pong mechanism) Enzyme inhibition types of inhibition, determination of Ki, suicide inhibitor.
Mechanism of enzyme action: General mechanistic principle, factors associated with catalytic efficiency: proximity, orientation, distortion of strain, acid-base, nucleophilic and covalent catalysis.

Techniques for studying mechanisms of action, chemical modification of active site groups, specific examples- : chymotrypsin, Isozyme, GPDH, aldolase, RNase, Carboxypeptidase and alcohol dehydrogenase.
Enzyme regulation: Product inhibition, feed-backcontrol, covalent modification.

units.title: UNIT - III
topics: Allosteric enzymes with special reference to aspartate transcarboxylase and phosphofructokinase. Qualitative description of concerted and sequential models. Negative cooperativity and half site reactivity.

Enzyme - Enzyme interaction, Protein ligand binding, measurements analysis of binding isotherm, cooperativity, Hill and scatchard plots, kinetics of allosteric enzymes. Isoenzymes- multiple forms of enzymes with special reference to lactate dehydrogenase. Multienzyme complexes. Ribozymes.
Multifunctional enzyme- eg Fatty Acid synthase.

units.title: UNIT - IV
topics: Enzyme Technology: Methods for large scale production of enzymes.
Immobilized enzyme and their comparison with soluble enzymes, Methods for immobilization of enzymes. Immobilized enzyme reactors. Application of Immobilized and soluble enzyme in health and industry.

Application to fundamental studies of biochemistry. Enzyme electrodes. Thermal stability and catalytic efficiency of enzyme, site directed mutagenesis and enzyme engineering- selected examples, Delivery system for protein pharmaceuticals, structure function relationship in enzymes, structural motifs and enzyme evolution.
Methods for protein sequencing. Methods for analysis of secondary and tertiary structures of enzymes.
Protein folding invitro &invivo.

papers.name: Genomics & Proteomics

units.title: UNIT I
topics: Introduction to Genomics, DNA sequencing methods - manual & automated: Maxam & Gilbert and Sangers method. Pyrosequencing, Genome Sequencing: Shotgun & Hierarchical (clone contig) methods, Computer tools for sequencing projects: Genome sequence assembly software.

units.title: UNIT II
topics: Managing and Distributing Genome Data: Web based servers and softwares for genomeanalysis: ENSEMBL, VISTA, UCSC Genome Browser, NCBI genome. Selected Model Organisms' Genomes and Databases.

units.title: UNIT III
topics: Introduction to protein structure, Chemical properties of proteins. Physical interactions that determine the property of proteins. Short-range interactions, electrostatic forces, van der waal interactions, hydrogen bonds, Hydrophobic interactions. Determination of sizes (Sedimentation analysis, gel filtration, SDS-PAGE); Native PAGE, Determination of covalent structures - Edman degradation.

units.title: UNIT IV
topics: IntroductiontoProteomics,Analysisofproteomes.2D-PAGE.Samplepreparation,solubilization, reduction,resolution.
Reproducibility of 2D-PAGE. Mass spectrometry based methods for protein identification. De novo sequencing using mass spectrometric data.
